scripts.typecheck: for p in hello shared sentinel reconciler; do (cd $p && bun run typecheck) || exit 1; done
scripts.test: for p in hello shared sentinel reconciler; do (cd $p && bun test) || exit 1; done
scripts.build: for p in sentinel reconciler; do (cd $p && bun cre-compile main.ts dist/$p.wasm) || exit 1; done
